title: O Pioneers!
summary: Set on the Nebraska prairie in the early 20th century, O Pioneers! follows Alexandra Bergson, a strong-willed Swedish-American woman who takes charge of her family's struggling farm after her father’s death. As she navigates love, loss, and the harsh realities of frontier life, Alexandra becomes a successful landowner and shapes the future of her community. The novel explores themes of nature’s power, individual determination, and the sacrifices required to build a life in a new country.
